instruction.name: xvsetanyeqz.d
instruction.description: Set the condition code if any d element is non-zero/equal to zero.

latencies.notes: vj -> fcc. The chain closes through movcf2gr (9 cycles) and vreplgr2vr.w (1 cycle), so 10 cycles of helper latency are subtracted; treat the value as approximate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc0, $xr8; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc1, $xr9; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc2, $xr10; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc3, $xr11; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc4, $xr12; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc5, $xr13; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc6, $xr14; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc7, $xr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr1, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4' --asm 'xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc0, $xr8; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc1, $xr9; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc2, $xr10; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc3, $xr11; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc4, $xr12; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc5, $xr13; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc6, $xr14; xvsetanyeqz.d $fcc7, $xr15'
